product_overview: ATRION is a SaaS platform for creating, optimizing, and exporting professional resumes, with AI-powered ATS analysis and LinkedIn profile auditing. It helps users build stronger job applications, tailor resumes to specific roles, and download polished PDF versions.
core_goals: Create a professional resume from scratch
Import an existing resume into the editor
Analyze a resume for ATS compatibility and improve it with AI
Adapt a resume to a specific job description
Audit a LinkedIn profile and get actionable improvement suggestions
Search for job openings by role and location
Manage resume drafts from a central dashboard
Customize resume templates, colors, and PDF output

features.name: Autentication
features.description: Users can register, sign in, and access the authenticated areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill in account details -> Submit the registration form -> See the authenticated experience begin
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email and password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Choose social sign-in -> Complete the external sign-in flow -> See the dashboard

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Users can review their resume list and start common resume actions from one place.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View the list of resumes -> Open an existing resume for editing
Navigate to /dashboard -> View the list of resumes -> Create a new resume
Navigate to /dashboard -> View the list of resumes -> Remove a resume from the account
Navigate to /dashboard -> View the list of resumes -> View the ATS score for a resume

features.name: Resume Creation and Editing
features.description: Users can create or update a resume through a multi-step editor with live preview, templates, and export options.
user_flows: Navigate to /resumes/new -> Start a new resume -> Navigate through the editor steps -> Fill in personal details -> Add professional experience -> Add education -> Add technical skills -> Add optional projects -> Add optional languages -> Add optional certifications -> Review the live preview -> Save the resume
Navigate to /editor/[id] -> Update personal details -> Update professional experience -> Update education -> Update technical skills -> Review the live preview -> Save the resume
Navigate to /editor/[id] -> Select a template -> Change the color scheme -> Review the updated preview -> Save the resume
Navigate to /editor/[id] -> Review the preview -> Download the resume as PDF

features.name: Resume Import
features.description: Users can upload an existing PDF or DOCX resume and extract its content into a new editable resume.
user_flows: Navigate to /resumes/new -> Upload a PDF or DOCX file -> Wait for the import to process -> Review the extracted resume content -> Continue editing the resume

features.name: ATS Analysis with AI
features.description: Users can analyze a resume with AI to get an ATS score, improvement suggestions, and recommended rewrites.
user_flows: Navigate to /editor/[id] -> Request AI analysis -> Optionally enter a target job -> View the ATS score -> Review prioritized improvement suggestions -> Apply the suggested corrections
Navigate to /editor/[id] -> Request AI analysis -> View the ATS score and keyword gaps -> Update the resume content -> Save the improved version

features.name: Job-Specific Resume Adaptation
features.description: Users can tailor an existing resume to match a target job description using AI.
user_flows: Navigate to /editor/[id] -> Request job adaptation -> Paste the job description -> Review the adapted resume changes -> Save the adapted version
Navigate to /editor/[id] -> Request job adaptation -> Paste the job description -> Review the change log -> Keep or discard the changes

features.name: LinkedIn Audit
features.description: Users can paste LinkedIn profile content and receive a scored audit with actionable advice.
user_flows: Navigate to /linkedin -> Paste LinkedIn profile text -> Select a professional area -> Optionally enter a target job -> Submit the audit -> View the score and improvement suggestions
Navigate to /linkedin -> Paste LinkedIn profile text -> Submit the audit -> Open a previous audit result from the audit history

features.name: Job Search
features.description: Users can search for open roles by keyword and location and open external job listings.
user_flows: Navigate to /jobs -> Enter a role or keyword -> Enter a location -> Search for jobs -> Review the results list -> Open an external job posting
Navigate to /jobs -> Search with a role keyword and location -> Refine the search terms -> Review the updated results

features.name: User Settings
features.description: Users can view and update their account-related preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Review current account settings -> Update personal preferences -> Save the changes
